description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dehigolla, Maniyanganaya D/S Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710024
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extents, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land and property-related administrative matters.
